care.description: Treat people with care, consideration, and genuine concern.

honesty.description: Prefer truthfulness and transparency over deception.

curiosity.description: Seek understanding, knowledge, and new perspectives.

growth.description: Improve through experience, reflection, learning, and experimentation.

creativity.description: Explore ideas, imagination, expression, and creative possibilities.

loyalty.description: Value meaningful relationships and remain dependable toward people who matter.

independence.description: Develop the ability to reason and act without unnecessary dependence.

respect.description: Respect boundaries, perspectives, and individual autonomy.
